【Before Test】

    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

source_snapshot.criteria: Defines the maximum rated output power of the PSU.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$DUT_USER@$DUT_IP"  "echo ---pmbus_names---; head -n 1 /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/name 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'pmbus|psu|power' || echo no_pmbus_dev; echo ---i2c_buses---; sudo i2cdetect -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'smbus|i2c' || echo no_i2c_tools; echo ---reg_MFR_POUT_MAX---; sudo i2cget -f -y ${PMBUS_BUS:?set PSU i2c bus} ${PMBUS_ADDR:?set PSU i2c addr} 0xB6 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: enumerate the hwmon PMBus + i2c buses on the DUT so the MFR_POUT_MAX register (0x0xB6, max output-power factory limit) can be read; then, once the user supplies the PSU i2c bus+address, read the register with i2cget/i2ctransfer and return the FULL value. Agent returns the PMBus/i2c enumeration + the register value once bus/addr are given.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: requires the PSU to be PMBus-connected and the exact PSU i2c bus/address from the board schematic; reading a raw PMBus register needs i2c-tools on the DUT. State: read-only, but target bus/address must be verified against the board before using i2cget.

original_test_intent: Read the identified PSU's manufacturer-defined maximum rated output power and verify the decoded wattage and rating type against the approved SKU specification.
original_method: Resolve the MFR_POUT_MAX command, applicable output domain and continuous/peak semantics, perform the approved read-only transaction, retain and decode the full response, compare to the SKU rating, repeat unchanged and preserve management evidence.
manual_activity: No electrical loading is part of this capability-reporting row. Engineering supplies the PSU rating definition and target mapping; raw acquisition, decoding, repeatability and comparison are machine-executable.
required_inputs: PSU SKU/firmware and authoritative bus/address ownership map
Vendor MFR_POUT_MAX transaction, response width, PEC, numeric format, scaling and power units
Definition of output domain and whether the maximum is continuous, peak, derated or model-specific
Expected rated power and comparison tolerance/rule
Approved non-forced reader/version, authenticated access, one-user approval and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Do not assume 0xB6, byte width, numeric mode, watts or continuous/peak semantics.
Do not use forced access, blind scans or writes; do not create load, change power limits or power-cycle the PSU.
Preserve rather than clear logs and use authenticated transport.
Stop on target ambiguity, undecodable data, bus error or PSU/BMC/host change.
No automatic retry with another command/address/width or reset.
agent_execution_scope: Verify PSU identity, rating definition and exact read-only transaction before approval.
Acquire complete raw MFR_POUT_MAX data and record tool/transport status.
Decode power with unit/rating type, repeat unchanged and compare against the approved SKU value.
Collect read-only output and log context; present evidence without a formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Provide the vendor command semantics, power-domain/rating type and expected SKU value.
Approve the target/read path and recovery plan.
Resolve vendor-specific interpretation and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not acceptance-ready: 0xB6 and byte semantics are not sourced, `-f` may bypass bus ownership, SSH is insecure, only one hwmon name is examined, ipmitool is unused and `0x0xB6` is malformed in the description.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor/board-approved target-locked non-forced transaction through authenticated transport and decode the raw value with the documented power format and rating type.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 remain unchanged; no wattage or rating type is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the query to the exact PSU SKU and rating definition, capture two identical approved reads, decode into watts and compare to the specified continuous/peak/derated value.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the identified PSU SKU/firmware and mapped PMBus path.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record vendor register-map/rating-document revision, PSU/BMC firmware and reader version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-supplied PSU vendor power-rating and command documentation; this review does not endorse generic 0xB6 semantics.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds rating-type provenance and raw-to-watt traceability without expanding into a load test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: It confirms the reported maximum rating, not actual delivered power, regulation or overload behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: SKU, rating type/domain, register/encoding, unit, expected value, target map and reader.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A peak value compared with a continuous specification, or a wrong numeric format, can produce a false result.

project_override_considerations: A vendor utility or BMC API is acceptable if it preserves the same SKU, rating-type and raw/decoded evidence. An approved project wattage applies only to that plan and must not be generalized to all PSU variants.
expected_evidence: PSU SKU/firmware and vendor rating/command document revision
Exact approved transaction, tool version and two complete raw responses
Decoded watts, numeric format and comparison with expected rating/tolerance
Preserved PSU/BMC/log context and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently request maximum rated PSU output power. The source's absence of wattage and rating type is a project input gap, not contradictory source text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The requested inventory value is clear. Missing SKU-specific encoding and expected rating affect readiness rather than making the case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject the guessed 0xB6 forced byte read and the unsupported claim that it directly represents a factory power limit.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its power-domain and peak/continuous gates plus no-load boundary; reclassify to FULLY AUTOMATABLE because the core query is deterministic after inputs.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes rating semantics explicit and prevents reported capacity from being confused with delivered-load validation.

review_improvement: This record requires an auditable SKU/rating definition and raw decode, eliminates the unsupported register shortcut, and keeps the evidence claim within inventory reporting rather than electrical performance.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core evidence is a static manufacturer rating read. Human input defines which rating and value apply, but no human action is needed for acquisition or comparison. Under V3.1, that makes the case FULLY AUTOMATABLE once ready.
